resolved_findings.observed_initial_issue: Dirty registration forced checking only for symbol_validate despite step accepting arbitrary PolicyConfig. A supported state could remain available for a revised false predicate under unchanged-source file_validate. This was outside the frozen workload but within the initial public method signature.
resolved_findings.resolution: step now rejects all policies except symbol_validate and intentional keep_all before touching owned state; authored regression passes.

resolved_findings.observed_initial_issue: Rotation with odd-repetition reversal groups four variants into rank parity classes, unlike the old three-variant cycle.
resolved_findings.resolution: Latest variant_order reverses whole four-rotation cycles. Static review confirms each variant occupies each position twice per eight-repetition cycle; regression passes.

ownership_and_registration.input_boundary: Exact Claim/Provenance/ResearchContext types, recursive immutable-value validation, full JSON schema reparse and owned frozen copies. Context fields, roots, limits and run binding validated. Ordinary new object or same-ID predicate/provenance/context edits invalidate the negative witness and force the next symbol_validate check.
ownership_and_registration.fast_path: Repeated registration skips work only for the exact originally submitted immutable object identities. Owned copies remain separate from submitted objects. Equal-but-new objects conservatively pay registration and validation.
ownership_and_registration.actual_result_boundary: Fresh owner either executes validate_claim or once verifies a trusted actual ValidationResult with schema reparse, claim/commit/input-hash identity, module/definition/source witness, root visibility and size limit. MemoryState and foreign witnesses cannot initialize it.
ownership_and_registration.last_actual_lineage: Negative witness is owned by the entry and exact registered input bundle. Guards match last_checked_commit, stale/unavailable/mismatch state, owned provenance identity and regular module OIDs in both snapshots to the last actual negative module. Actual uncertainty/support clears the witness. Policy-switch recovery validates.
ownership_and_registration.publication_boundary: Registration is a pending epoch transition: state exposed between register and step is still historical prior-epoch state, not a checked result for newly registered inputs. The frozen runner registers then checks before reporting/publishing current state.

measurement_review.original_three_variants: Dispatched to unchanged original run_history; protocol hashes and authored test verify original implementation bytes and exact workload match.
new_variant_charged_each_reset: Recursive immutable/schema validation and owned cloning
Actual parent-result ingress normalization and input-hash/source-witness verification
charged_each_step: Registration attempt, and full re-registration for each new input object/epoch
Carry eligibility and module metadata checks
Owned witness replacement after actual validation
measurement_review.audit_hashes: Trace-only claim/provenance/context SHA digests were removed from the domain bundle and are computed only in capture outside measured timing. Cold actual input-hash verification remains charged.
measurement_review.setup: Shared authored Git/snapshot/index/reference construction remains outside maintenance, with candidate-only original context binding setup separately disclosed.
measurement_review.warmup_and_order: Two fixed warmup blocks precede 21 paired repetitions; balanced whole-cycle rotation order, identical pack sizes, own reset/sequential state for every variant.
measurement_review.checks_and_profiles: Correctness matches fresh semantic state fields outside timing; exact suppressed verdict/reason checked. Timed block endpoint/counter assertions run after sample boundaries. Profiles are a separate post-timing phase with their own work counts.
measurement_review.interpretation: No optimization success or elapsed benefit is established. Normalization, deep checking, cloning and ingress verification may exceed old hash-loop costs on these short histories. Judge measured paired CPU/wall variation and separate limiter profiles before any recommendation; no corpus or end-to-end index savings follow.

bounded_premises: Genuine production snapshots/indexes are constructed with the matching registered context and complete authentic ChangeSet.
Trusted sealed builder supplies actual validation results; input hashes are consistency checks, not execution authentication.
Ordinary frozen-schema APIs are the trust boundary. Arbitrary __dict__, object.__setattr__, class-definition or private-owner tampering is not a supported Python security boundary.
Only the fixed 17 authored histories and explicit symbol_validate/keep_all owner policies are claimed.
